questions.question: What specific check will prove the single-page business listings are correctly displayed?
questions.rationale: Requirement R2 is a MUST but currently lacks an acceptance criterion.

questions.question: What exact test confirms that the driving directions and map link work correctly?
questions.rationale: Requirement R3 is a MUST but currently lacks an acceptance criterion.

questions.question: Should the website load completely in under three seconds on mobile phones?
